title: Live-Cell Imaging of Astrocytes Exposed to HiLyte™ 488-labeled α-Synuclein
author: Elena Coccia

steps.title: Coat 96-well plate with gelatin
steps.instruction: Prepare a 0.1% gelatin coating for the 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 0.1 g of gelatin in 100 mL of sterile PBS to create a 0.1% gelatin solution.
Add 100 µL of the gelatin solution to each well of the 96-well plate.
Incubate the plate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Remove the gelatin solution and wash the wells with 200 µL of sterile PBS.

steps.title: Plate astrocytes
steps.instruction: Seed astrocytes into the coated plate at a density of 10,000 cells per well.

substeps.instruction: Collect astrocytes with Tryple, prepare a cell suspension, and count the cells.
Add 100 µL of the cell suspension to each well of the gelatin-coated 96-well plate.

steps.title: Change media to mature astrocyte media
steps.instruction: Replace the initial media with mature astrocyte media 24 hours after plating.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the old media from each well.
Add 100 µL of mature astrocyte media.

steps.title: Treat cells with α-synuclein and Hoechst
steps.instruction: Apply HiLyte™ 488-labeled α-synuclein and Hoechst 33342 to the astrocytes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a working solution of HiLyte™ 488-labeled α-synuclein at 2 µg/mL in mature astrocyte media.
Add 100 µL of the α-synuclein solution and 10 µL of Hoechst 33342 (10 µg/mL) to each well.

steps.title: Perform live-cell imaging
steps.instruction: Capture images at 3, 6, 12, and 24 hours post-treatment.

substeps.instruction: At each specified time point, remove the media and wash the cells with 100 µL of pre-warmed PBS.
Add 100 µL of fresh mature astrocyte media to each well.
Place the plate in a fluorescence microscope and capture images.

steps.title: Final media change
steps.instruction: Perform a final media change after the last imaging session (24 hours).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the media and wash with 100 µL of PBS.
Add 100 µL of fresh mature astrocyte media.
